_comment: The travel map of central Gaul. One cell is roughly 12 km. Rows are drawn north (top) to south. Rules: src/core/world_data.gd.

locations.name: Brigodunon
locations.desc: Home. A hill fort of the Cadurci above the Oltis, behind a rampart of stone and timber.

locations.name: The Grotto of the Hanging Dead
locations.desc: A cave in the limestone where the old dead were hung for the birds. Nobody goes there now. Somebody does.

locations.name: Vindomagos
locations.desc: A farming village on the north bank of the Oltis. Salt, grain, and gossip.

locations.name: The ford at the Oltis
locations.desc: The only good crossing of the Oltis for a day in either direction.

locations.name: Uxellodunum
locations.desc: The great stronghold of the Cadurci, on its cliff above the Duranius.
locations.closed_text: The road goes on, but this part of Gaul isn't built yet. The way home is open.

locations.name: Gergovia
locations.desc: The Arverni capital on its plateau. Whoever holds it holds the revolt.
locations.shut_text: The gates are shut. Gobannitio's men hold the plateau, and the valley below it is full of his nephew's ragged army. Nobody gets in, and anyone who tries to get out is looked at very closely. Come back when one of them has won.

locations.name: Avaricum
locations.desc: The richest city in Gaul, behind walls of stone and timber.

locations.name: Noviodunum
locations.desc: Caesar's depot on the Liger. Hostages, horses, grain.
locations.closed_text: The road goes on, but this part of Gaul isn't built yet. The way home is open.

locations.name: Cenabum
locations.desc: The Carnute trading town where the revolt began.
locations.closed_text: The road goes on, but this part of Gaul isn't built yet. The way home is open.

locations.name: The Carnute forest
locations.desc: Where the druids of all Gaul meet once a year.
locations.closed_text: The road goes on, but this part of Gaul isn't built yet. The way home is open.

locations.name: Bibracte
locations.desc: The Aeduan capital. Rome's oldest friends in Gaul.
locations.closed_text: The road goes on, but this part of Gaul isn't built yet. The way home is open.

locations.name: Alesia
locations.desc: A hill town of the Mandubii.
locations.closed_text: The road goes on, but this part of Gaul isn't built yet. The way home is open.

encounters.text: Wolves. Winter has made them bold.
Two wolves are shadowing you through the brush.
Men on the road with weapons and no village. In a war, that's a trade.
A family on the road, carrying everything they own.
A trader with two mules, a guard, and opinions.
Roman foragers, a long way from their camp, stripping a farm. They see you.
